findings.evidence: Lines 131-144 depend only on `f`, `hf`, `hγ` and `hfibre`, so the factoring is possible; the rubric's 50-line threshold applies.
findings.fix: Extract `H` as a preliminary lemma next to `preimage_snd_left_eq_range_whiskerLeft_left` (`(lift (snd X Y) f).left` maps `(snd X Y).left ⁻¹' {y₀.left point}` into `Set.range (lift y₀ z₀).left`, hence finite), and the tensor-unit finiteness as its own `have`/instance.
findings.issue: `rigidity_of_isAlgClosed` runs ~70 lines (109-179). The finiteness step `H` (131-144) is a self-contained statement about `lift (snd X Y) f` on the fibre over `y₀`, and the nested `Finite (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))).left` derivation (140-143) is generic.

summary: Proofs are free of `change`/`show` and of undocumented defeq manipulation, but two places rest on long ordered rewrite chains that fight simp normal form, and the abelian-variety proof duplicates a nine-lemma simp set plus a positional `rw` chain verbatim.
